_comment: Curated resource library backing the deterministic pathway fallback. Every entry is a real, free-or-cheap, currently-published resource (Prompt 3 Rule 6: do not recommend anything you are not confident exists). Each skill carries three DISJOINT options so the three pathways never converge on the same reading list.
